item.title: North Korea Calls Talk of Nuclear Disarmament a “Delusion”… Continues to Condemn Korea-EU Statement and Korea-US Consultations (북 “핵무장 해제 운운은 망상”…한-EU 성명·한-미 협의 연일 비난)
item.description:
North Korea is intensifying pressure on South Korea by issuing a series of statements condemning the Korea-European Union (EU) joint statement and Korea-US-Japan consultations, which include content that does not recognize North Korea as a nuclear-armed state. (북한이 한국-유럽연합(EU) 공동성명과 한·미·일 협의 등에서 북한의 핵보유를 인정하지 않는다는 내용이 담긴 것을 비난하는 성명을 잇따라 내놓으며 한국을 압박하고 있다.)

On the 14th, North Korea, through a statement by a spokesperson of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs published by the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA), criticized as “utter nonsense and a hollow delusion” the fact that the US and South Korea held a Nuclear Consultative Group (NCG) meeting, a mechanism for extended deterrence, and reaffirmed the goal of North Korea’s denuclearization. (북한은 14일 조선중앙통신을 통해 발표한 외무성 대변인 담화를 통해 한-미가 확장억제 협의체인 핵협의그룹(NCG) 회의를 열고 북한 비핵화 목표를 재확인한 것과 관련해 “교전 상대방의 핵무장 해제를 운운하는 것이야말로 어불성설이며 공허한 망상”이라고 비난했다.)

Earlier, on the 11th, the US and South Korea held the 6th NCG meeting in Seoul and issued a joint press statement affirming “the common goal of North Korea’s denuclearization.” Subsequently, on the 12th, officials from the US, South Korea, and Japan in charge of North Korean affairs met in Tokyo, Japan, and reaffirmed “the goal of complete denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula” and efforts to implement UN Security Council resolutions against North Korea. (앞서, 한-미는 지난 11일 서울에서 핵협의그룹 제6차 회의를 열고 “북한 비핵화에 대한 공동의 목표를 확인했다”는 내용을 담은 공동언론성명을 발표했다. 이어 12일에는 한·미·일 3국의 북한 문제 담당 당국자들이 일본 도쿄에서 만나 ‘한반도의 완전한 비핵화 목표’와 유엔(UN) 안전보장이사회 대북 결의 이행 노력을 재확인했다.)

In response, the North Korean Foreign Ministry spokesperson stated, “We sternly denounce and reject the collective nuclear confrontation racket of the US, Japan, and South Korea, and the impure attempts of Western countries to force illegal acts upon a sovereign state on the international stage.” They further emphasized, “The meaningless anti-DPRK rhetoric and nuclear threat cooperation of the US and its followers cannot affect our irreversible status as a nuclear weapons state in any way,” and stressed that “denuclearization is a matter that has been finally and irreversibly concluded.” (이에 대해 북 외무성 대변인은 “집단적 성격을 띤 미일한의 핵대결 소동과 국제무대에서 주권국가에 위헌행위를 강요하려는 서방나라들의 불순한 기도를 엄정히 규탄배격한다”고 했다. 이어 “미국과 추종세력들의 무의미한 반공화국 비난 수사와 핵위협 공조는 되돌릴 수 없는 우리의 핵보유국지위에 아무러한 영향도 미칠 수 없다”며 “‘비핵화'는 최종적으로 되돌릴 수 없이 종결된 사안”이라고 강조했다.)

Prior to this, on the 13th, the North Korean Foreign Ministry issued a statement in the name of the “Spokesperson for the Tenth Bureau,” reacting to the recent Korea-EU summit joint statement which criticized North Korea’s nuclear development and the close ties between North Korea and Russia, while strongly condemning President Lee Jae-myung as having “thrown off the mask of peace.” (북한 외무성은 이에 앞서 지난 13일 ‘10국 대변인’ 명의로 담화를 내어, 최근 한-유럽연합 정상회담 공동성명에 북한 핵개발과 북러 밀착을 비판하는 내용이 담긴 데 반발하면서, 이재명 대통령이 ‘평화의 가면을 내던졌다'고 맹비난했다.)

The spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry’s Tenth Bureau targeted South Korea, saying, “The Korea-EU joint statement is nothing less than a clear violation of our state’s sovereignty and a grave hostile act, discarding the false signs such as ‘respect for systems’ and ‘non-pursuit of hostility’ that they have been tirelessly boasting about.” They further claimed, “The ruler of South Korea has thrown off the cumbersome ‘peace’ mask he was wearing,” and argued, “With this declaration of confrontation, the ruler of South Korea has proven to the world the reality that there can be no ‘peaceful coexistence’ between the North and South (Koreas), and that they can only remain eternally hostile two-state relations, as well as proving that they are a confederate sharing the same heart with the Ukrainian puppet regime.” The statement also criticized South Korea as “the ‘dagger’ of the US for the invasion of Joseon and the Asian continent,” describing it as South Korea’s substance and destiny. The Tenth Bureau of the Foreign Ministry is a newly established organization under the Foreign Ministry after North Korea declared inter-Korean relations as “hostile two-state relations” and abolished existing organizations for inter-Korean affairs, with its spokesperson appearing for the first time. (외무성 10국 대변인은 한-유럽연합 공동성명이 “우리 국가에 대한 명백한 주권침해, 엄중한 적대행위로서 지금껏 입 닳도록 떠들어 온 ‘체제존중', ‘적대행위 불추구'와 같은 위장간판을 스스로 내팽개친 것이나 다름없다”고 한국을 겨냥했다. 이어 “한국의 집권자가 거치장스럽게 쓰고 있던 ‘평화'의 가면을 내던졌다”며 “한국 집권자는 이번 대결 선언으로 조한(북남) 사이에 ‘평화공존'은 있을 수 없으며 영원히 적대적인 두 국가 관계일 수밖에 없다는 현실, 우크라이나 괴뢰들과 속통이 같은 공범임을 세계 앞에 입증했다”고 주장했다. 그러면서 “조선과 아시아대륙 침략을 위한 미국의 ‘단검'이 바로 한국의 실체이고 숙명”이라고 비난했다. 외무성 10국은 남북관계를 ‘적대적 두 국가’로 선언한 북한이 기존 대남기구를 폐지한 뒤 외무성 산하에 신설된 대담 업무 담당 조직이며, 10국 대변인은 이번에 처음 등장했다.)

President Lee, together with Antonio Costa, President of the European Council, and Ursula von der Leyen, President of the European Commission, held a summit in Brussels on the 10th and adopted a joint statement containing phrases such as “strongly condemn the illegal military cooperation between Russia and North Korea” and “North Korea will never be recognized as a nuclear weapon state under the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT).” (이 대통령과 안토니우 코스타 유럽연합 정상회의 상임의장, 우르줄라 폰데어라이엔 집행위원장은 지난 10일 브뤼셀에서 정상회담을 한 뒤 “러시아-북한 간 불법적 군사협력을 강력히 규탄”, “북한은 핵확산금지조약(NPT) 상 핵보유국으로 결코 인정되지 않을 것” 등의 문구가 담긴 공동성명을 채택했다.)

In response to North Korea’s condemnation of the Korea-EU joint statement, the Office of the President (Presidential Office) stated, “The government will consistently pursue a policy of peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula with a long-term perspective.” An official from the Office of the President added, “The European Union also supports our government’s policy for easing tensions and establishing peace on the Korean Peninsula.” (청와대는 이날 북한의 한-유럽연합 공동성명 비난에 대해 “정부는 긴 안목을 가지고 한반도 평화공존 정책을 일관되게 추진할 것”이라고 말했다. 청와대 관계자는 “유럽연합도 한반도의 긴장 완화와 평화 정착을 위한 우리 정부의 정책을 지지한다”고 밝혔다.)

This move by North Korea appears to reflect its growing confidence, bolstered by the recent visit of Chinese President Xi Jinping to North Korea and the North Korea-China summit, which elevated North Korea’s status as a “partner in multipolar order.” It is noteworthy that North Korea is targeting not only inter-Korean relations but also Korea-US, Korea-US-Japan, and Korea-EU relations as an equal partner with China and Russia. The intention behind the Foreign Ministry statement labeling South Korea as a “confederate with Ukrainian puppets” and the “dagger of the US” is significant. (북한의 이런 움직임은 최근 시진핑 중국 국가주석의 방북과 북중 정상회담을 통해 중국의 ‘다극질서 파트너’로 지위가 격상된 북한의 자신감을 반영하는 것으로 보인다. 북한이 남북관계를 넘어, 중국, 러시아와 대등한 파트너로서 한미, 한미일, 한-유럽연합 관계를 겨냥하고 있는 점이 주목된다. 외무성 담화가 한국을 ‘우크라니아 괴뢰들과 공범’, ‘미국의 단검’으로 지칭하는 의도다.)

Professor Im Eul-chul of Kyungnam University’s Institute of Far Eastern Studies pointed out, “The Foreign Ministry spokesperson’s statement expands the level of the message and the target to a global dimension.” Professor Im said, “It is a force to demand recognition of North Korea’s ‘de facto nuclear weapons state’ status, and a build-up process to justify the inevitability of North Korea-China-Russia military cooperation and actually promote it,” and predicted that “North Korea will further strengthen its frontal breakthrough line based on the North Korea-China and North Korea-Russia alliances in response to the security cooperation among Korea, the US, and Japan.” (임을출 경남대 극동문제연구소 교수는 “외무성 대변인 담화는 메시지의 격과 대상을 글로벌 차원으로 확대”했다고 짚었다. 임 교수는 “북한의 ‘사실상의 핵보유국' 지위를 인정하라는 강요이자 북·중·러 군사협력의 불가피성을 정당화하고 실제 추진하기 위한 빌드업 과정”이라면서, “한·미·일의 안보 공조에 맞서 북중, 북러 동맹을 축으로 하는 정면 돌파 노선을 더욱 강화해 나갈 것”으로 예상했다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr Rome/Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr 로마/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jo Seung-rae: "The Ruling Party Must Be a Big Vessel" — President Lee's Message Targeting Chung Cheong-rae? A Distorted Interpretation (조승래 “‘여당은 큰 그릇’ 이 대통령 메시지가 정청래 겨냥? 왜곡된 해석”)
item.description:
Jo Seung-rae, Secretary-General of the Democratic Party of Korea, refuted on the 14th interpretations that President Lee Jae-myung's message—that "the ruling party should focus more on 'the language of responsibility' rather than 'the language of conviction'"—was aimed at Chung Cheong-rae's leadership, calling it "a distortion of the president's intent." <<>> At a press conference held at the National Assembly that day, Secretary-General Jo said this regarding President Lee's X (formerly Twitter) post from the previous day, stating, "Interpretations can vary." In the post, President Lee said, "The ruling party's passion should be directed toward 'the entire nation,' not 'our faction,'" and urged the Democratic Party to "play the role of a 'big vessel' that adjusts conflicts and minimizes backlash through continuous dialogue and communication, rather than confrontation and exclusion." <<>> In response, Secretary-General Jo emphasized, "Rather than targeting a specific individual or leadership, he made those remarks to stress the ruling party's responsibility in how it should approach state affairs after the local elections," adding, "Narrowly focusing on a specific person or leadership distorts the president's intent." He further noted, "Such an interpretation is not only inappropriate but also uses the president for other political purposes." <<>> The Democratic Party has established a committee to evaluate the June 3 local and by-elections. Secretary-General Jo said, "We will assess the party's preparation process, including the activities of the local election planning team, the formation and operation of candidate nomination management bodies, and the overall process of primary management campaigns," adding, "We must also evaluate how candidate campaign strategies and the messages and actions of government officials during the election process influenced public opinion." <<>> The Democratic Party is considering holding its national convention—where new party leadership will be elected on August 17—in Daejeon. To this end, it plans to form a national convention preparation committee after going through the Central Committee on the 16th, the Supreme Council meeting on the 24th, and the Party Affairs Committee on the 26th. <<>> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (조승래 더불어민주당 사무총장은 14일 “집권 여당은 신념의 언어보다는 ‘책임의 언어’에 더 집중해야 한다”는 이재명 대통령의 메시지가 정청래 지도부를 향한 것이 아니냐는 해석에 대해 “대통령의 뜻을 왜곡하는 것”이라고 반박했다.)

item.title: Cho Seung-rae: "Government officials' messages and their impact on election public opinion must be evaluated." (조승래 “정부 인사 메시지, 선거 여론에 미친 영향 평가해야”)
item.description:
Cho Seung-rae, Secretary-General of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 14th that through the recently established internal party body, the ‘June 3 Local and By-elections Evaluation Committee’ (the Committee), they will “evaluate how the messages and actions of government officials during the election process influenced public opinion.” (조승래 더불어민주당 사무총장이 최근 설치한 당내 기구인 ‘6·3 지방선거 및 재보궐선거 평가위원회’(위원회)를 통해 “선거과정 속에 정부 인사들의 메시지, 행보가 여론에 어떤 영향을 미쳤는지 평가할 것”이라고 14일 밝혔다.)

Secretary-General Cho held a press briefing at the National Assembly on the same day and said, “The Evaluation Committee will assess the party’s preparation process, including the activities of the local election planning group, the formation and operation of candidate nomination management bodies, and the overall process of primary management campaigns.” He added, “We must also evaluate the campaign strategies of candidate camps and how the messages and actions of government officials during the election process affected public opinion.” The Election Evaluation Committee, whose establishment was approved at the Supreme Council meeting on the 10th, is co-chaired by Lee Jae-young, head of the Democratic Research Institute, and Hong Chang-min, former head of the Seoul City Party Candidate Nomination Management Committee. (조 사무총장은 이날 국회에서 기자간담회를 열어 “평가위원회는 지방선거 기획단 활동과 공천관리 기구들의 구성과 운영, 경선관리 캠페인의 전반적 과정 등 당내의 준비과정을 평가하게 된다”며 “후보자 캠프의 캠페인 전략, 선거 과정 중 나왔던 정부 인사들의 메시지 행보가 여론에 어떻게 영향을 미쳤는지도 평가해야 한다”고 말했다. 지난 10일 최고위에서 설치를 의결한 선거평가위는 이재영 민주연구원장과 홍창민 전 서울시당 공천관리위원장이 공동위원장을 맡고 있다.)

In response to a question about “the messages and actions of government officials,” Secretary-General Cho replied, “For example, various articles about the next party leadership were published during and after the early voting period. We must naturally evaluate whether those were appropriate and how messages on various issues actually influenced public opinion, because the public makes decisions while considering such comprehensive messages.” (조 사무총장은 ‘정부 인사들의 메시지 행보’에 대한 질문에 “예를 들면 사전투표가 진행되고 종료되는 시점에 차기 당권 관련한 여러 기사가 나왔는데 그것들이 적절했는가, 여러 현안에 대한 메시지가 실제 여론에 어떤 영향을 줬는가 당연히 평가해야 한다”며 “국민들은 그런 종합적 메시지를 보면서 의사 결정을 하기 때문”이라고 답했다.)

He added, “While the election was in full swing, an article came out saying ‘(Kim Min-seok) resigns as Prime Minister and challenges for party leadership.’ The parties involved did not deny it. We need to assess whether that was appropriate.” He stated, “There were issues like the ‘fabricated indictment’ problem and the ‘Starbucks’ issue. Beyond the party’s internal campaign, we must track and investigate whether the response messages, including those inside and outside the party, were appropriate and how the public reacted.” He also noted, “For instance, in Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek (B) and North Jeolla, we showed a lack of focus on the election by linking it to the so-called next party leadership structure, revealing internal divisions. We must evaluate this coldly.” (그러면서 “선거가 한창 진행 중인데 ‘(김민석) 총리 그만두고 당권 도전한다’는 기사가 나왔다”며 “당사자들이 부인을 안 했는데, 그게 과연 적절했을까 평가해볼 필요가 있다”고 했다. 그는 “조작기소 문제, 스타벅스 문제 등의 이슈가 있었고, 그에 대한 당내 캠페인 뿐 아니라 당 안팎을 포함해 대응 메시지가 적절했는지, 국민들이 어떻게 반응했는지 추적 조사해야 한다”고 말했다. 또, “선거에 집중하지 못하고 예를 들면 경기 평택(을)과 전북에서 소위 차기 당권 구도와 연결지어 당내 균열을 보여줬다. 이에 대해 냉정하게 평가해야 한다”고 덧붙였다.)

However, when asked by reporters whether President Lee Jae-myung’s statements on current issues via X (formerly Twitter) would also be subject to evaluation, he responded, “The President didn’t do anything particularly significant aside from encouraging voter turnout.” He added, “When evaluating an election, we comprehensively judge internal and external factors. We look at the impact of messages on issues and elements within the party’s power structure that hinder unity.” (다만, 그는 이재명 대통령의 엑스(X)를 통한 현안 발언도 평가 대상에 들어가는 것이냐는 취재진 질문에 “대통령이 한 건 투표 독려 말고 특별한 건 없다고 보여진다”며 “선거 평가를 할 때는 당내외 요인을 종합 판단한다. 이슈에 대한 메시지의 영향, 당의 역학구조상 단결을 저해하는 요소 등을 보는 것”이라고 했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Exclusive] Prosecution Reform Task Force to Submit 'Multiple Proposals on Supplementary Investigation Request Authority' as Early as This Week ([단독] 검찰개혁추진단, 이르면 이번주 ‘보완수사요구권 복수안’ 제출)
item.description:
The Prosecution Reform Task Force under the Office of the Prime Minister has decided to submit two amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act to the Democratic Party of Korea as early as this week: one that grants only the authority to request supplementary investigations to prosecutors in the Public Prosecution Office, and another that provides a minimal level of supplementary investigation authority. (국무총리실 산하 검찰개혁추진단이 공소청 검사에게 보완수사 요구권만 주는 안과 최소한의 보완수사권을 주는 두 가지 형사소송법 개정안을 이르면 이번 주 안에 더불어민주당에 제출하기로 했다.)

According to a report by The Hankyoreh on the 14th, the Prosecution Reform Task Force, which is currently drafting amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act, has prepared two versions for the Public Prosecution Office, set to launch in October: an amendment that grants only the right to request supplementary investigations without providing supplementary investigation authority, and another that provides only a minimal level of supplementary investigation authority. The task force is known to have excluded compulsory investigation powers from the supplementary investigation authority, allowing only extremely limited investigations such as fact-checking or voluntary investigations. <<> President Lee Jae-myung, during a press conference marking his first anniversary in office on the 8th, cited examples where supplementary investigation authority is needed, such as cases referred to the prosecution after police investigations where "a resident registration number is missing, there is a possibility of a namesake, or fingerprint verification needs to be done precisely." He stated, "It would be good to hand over the issue of supplementary investigation authority to the National Assembly for discussion and not insist on the government's position." Government and ruling party officials said, "These two amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act will be submitted to the Democratic Party within this week." <<> Democratic Party Secretary General Jo Seung-rae said at a press briefing at the National Assembly that day, "While it is necessary to reach a conclusion quickly on the supplementary investigation authority issue, we can discuss the timeline only after the organization of the (second half of the) National Assembly is completed," adding, "Representative Jeong Cheong-rae's stance is clearly leaning toward abolishing the supplementary investigation authority." <<> Meanwhile, it is reported that the task force did not include in the amendment a plan, previously advocated by some, to transfer all cases investigated by the police to the Public Prosecution Office (comprehensive transfer) regardless of whether they are indicted. Since the adjustment of investigative authority between the police and the prosecution in 2021, the police only forward cases they deem necessary for indictment, while concluding cases where no charges are recognized. However, if a victim or complainant raises an objection, the police must transfer the case where they decided not to forward it to the prosecution. The task force is currently reviewing a plan to allow accusers to also file objections. <<> Additionally, if the Public Prosecution Office is not granted direct supplementary investigation authority, the task force is reportedly considering a bill granting fact-checking authority (supplementary inspection authority) but is leaning toward not including it at the final stage. <<> While some have argued that the current detention investigation period of up to 10 days for the police and 20 days for the prosecution needs to be adjusted since the prosecution's investigative authority will be significantly reduced, it appears that the detention investigation period will not be adjusted in this revision of the Criminal Procedure Act. <<> Reporters Jeong Hye-min, jhm@hani.co.kr, and Kim Chae-woon, cwk@hani.co.kr ( 14일 한겨레 취재 결과 형사소송법 개정안을 마련 중인 검찰개혁추진단은 오는 10월 출범하는 공소청에 △보완수사권은 주지 않은 채 보완수사요구권만 주는 개정안과 △최소한의 보완수사권만 부여하는 개정안 두 가지를 마련한 것으로 알려졌다. 추진단은 보완수사권에 강제수사권한은 빼고, 사실관계 확인이나 임의수사 정도의 극히 제한된 수사만 할 수 있도록 한 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Democracy says "can't give it", People Power says "hand it over" over National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee chairmanship (국회 법사위원장 놓고 민주 “못 줘” 국힘 “내 놔”)
item.description:
The ruling and opposition parties are fiercely at odds over the chairmanship of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, a key issue in negotiations to organize the second half of the 22nd National Assembly. The Democratic Party of Korea insists, "It is essential for the ruling party to hold the Legislation and Judiciary Committee chairmanship to quickly support the government's national agenda through legislation" and vows to "keep it," while the People Power Party pressures them to "hand it over," arguing, "The opposition party's insistence on keeping the Legislation and Judiciary Committee chairmanship ignores the stern public sentiment shown in the June 3 local elections." <<> People Power Party Senior Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon stated in a commentary on the 14th, "The only last bastion to check and neutralize the Democratic Party's unilateral rush of special counsel laws and the Ministry of Justice's cunning abuse of power is the Legislation and Judiciary Committee," adding, "The opposition party must take the Legislation and Judiciary Committee chairmanship to prevent the administration's judicial destruction schemes." Chief Deputy Floor Spokesperson Choi Soo-jin also issued a commentary on the same day, calling the "declaration of exclusive control over the Legislation and Judiciary Committee chairmanship a declaration of war to continue parliamentary dictatorship." <<> Democratic Party Floor Spokesperson Lee Joo-hee said in a written briefing on the 13th, "In the first half of the 22nd National Assembly, committees where the People Power Party held the chairmanship, such as the Political Affairs Committee, Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee, and National Defense Committee, were particularly slow in processing major reform tasks and livelihood-related bills," adding, "The public clearly remembers the People Power Party's outdated practices of bringing the National Assembly to a standstill by even blocking bipartisan livelihood bills with a comprehensive filibuster." <<> Previously, Democratic Party Floor Leader Han Byeong-do stated at an on-site Supreme Council meeting in Gwangju on the 12th, "The organization of the National Assembly must be completed by the 18th," and firmly said, "The Legislation and Judiciary Committee is not up for negotiation." In response, People Power Party Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik said that the "opposition party's Legislation and Judiciary Committee chairmanship" is "an essential element to end legislative dictatorship and restore a National Assembly of checks and balances." <<> Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (여야가 22대 국회 후반기 원 구성 협상의 핵심인 국회 법제사법위원장 자리를 두고 팽팽히 맞서고 있다. 더불어민주당은 “집권여당이 법사위원장을 하는 건 정부의 국정과제를 신속하게 입법으로 뒷받침하기 위해 필수적”이라며 ‘사수하겠다’ 하고, 국민의힘은 “야당이 법사위원장직을 사수하는 게 6·3 지방선거의 준엄한 민심”이라며 ‘내놓으라’고 압박하고 있다.)

item.title: Ahn Gyu-baek: "No Additional Conditions for Wartime Operational Control Transfer… Concerns It Could Become a Perpetual Deferral" (안규백 “전작권 전환 조건 추가 없다…‘백년하청’ 우려”)
item.description:
Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek on the 14th, responding to a question about whether the conditions for the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) previously agreed upon by South Korea and the United States can cope with modern warfare aspects like the emergence of drones, emphasized that there is no intention to add conditions for the OPCON recovery, stating, "The battlefield landscape changes day by day; if we keep adding conditions, wouldn't that become a perpetual deferral?" This marks the first time South Korea has publicly stated its stance of not accepting additional conditions for OPCON transfer. (안규백 국방부 장관은 14일 ‘과거 한국과 미국이 합의한 전시작전통제권(전작권) 전환의 조건이 드론의 등장 등 현대전 양상에 대처할 수 있겠느냐’는 물음에 대해 “하루가 다르게 전장 양상이 달라지는데, 그럼 조건이라는 게 백년하청 아니냐”며 전작권 회복 조건을 추가할 뜻이 없다고 강조했다. 한국이 전작권 조건 불가 입장을 공개적으로 밝힌 것은 처음이다.)

Minister Ahn made these remarks while appearing on KBS's "Sunday Diagnosis" program, saying, "We need to meet the conditions to recover OPCON, and then we should discuss those (changes in the battlefield environment)." He stressed, "Although the battlefield paradigm has changed significantly, our capabilities are sufficient." (안 장관은 이날 한국방송(KBS) 일요진단에 출연해 “조건을 충족해 전작권이 회복되고 그 다음에 그거(전장환경의 변화)는 논의해야 된다”며 이렇게 말했다. 그는 “전장 패러다임이 많이 바뀌었지만, 우리의 능력은 충분하다”고 강조했다.)

The reason he drew the line on adding new conditions, citing the idiom "a hundred years cannot clear the yellow river," is that no matter how hard South Korea tries, each time conditions are added, the recovery of OPCON is continually delayed. (그가 ‘백년이 지나도 누른색 황하가 맑아지기 어렵다’는 고사성어를 인용해 새로운 조건 추가에 선을 그은 이유는 한국이 아무리 노력해도 조건이 추가될 때마다 전작권 회복이 계속 늦춰졌기 때문이다.)

In February 2007, during the Roh Moo-hyun administration, the South Korea-U.S. defense ministers agreed to transfer OPCON by April 17, 2012. However, President Lee Myung-bak delayed the timeline to December 1, 2015, citing unstable security conditions such as North Korea's second nuclear test (2009) during the 2010 South Korea-U.S. summit. The Park Geun-hye administration, in April 2014, citing increased threats from North Korean nuclear and missile capabilities, agreed to transfer OPCON not at a specific time but when "mutually agreed conditions" are met. This "conditions-based transfer" framework has persisted to this day. (노무현 정부 때인 2007년 2월 한·미 국방장관은 “2012년 4월17일부로 전작권을 이양한다”고 합의했으나, 이명박 대통령은 2010년 6월 한-미 정상회담에서 북한의 2차 핵실험(2009년) 등 불안한 안보 상황을 들어 환수 시기를 2015년 12월1일로 늦췄다. 박근혜 정부는 2014년 4월 높아진 북핵·미사일 위협을 이유로 전환 시기를 특정하지 않고 ‘양국이 상호합의한 전환 조건’이 충족되는 시기에 전작권을 전환하기로 합의했다. 이런 ‘조건 기초 전환’ 틀이 지금까지 이어지고 있다.)

Minister Ahn stated that he would propose a target year for OPCON transfer to both countries' presidents by the end of this year. "Recovering OPCON within the term" is a key national task of the Lee Jae-myung administration. (안 장관은 전작권 전환 목표연도를 올해 말 양국 대통령에게 건의하겠다고 밝혔다. ‘임기 내 전작권 회복’이 이재명 정부 국정과제다.)

South Korea and the U.S. are advancing a three-phase evaluation and validation of the mission capability of the future Combined Forces Command, which will replace the current ROK-U.S. Combined Forces Command. The first phase, Initial Operational Capability (IOC), has been completed. The second phase, Full Operational Capability (FOC), has been evaluated, and validation is planned at the annual Security Consultative Meeting (SCM) scheduled for around November this year. Once this validation is complete, the defense ministers of South Korea and the U.S. will decide the target year for OPCON transfer and follow the procedure of recommending it to both presidents. After that, the defense ministers will complete the third phase, Full Mission Capability (FMC), evaluation and validation before recommending the transfer date to both presidents. If the defense ministers propose 2027 as the target year for OPCON transfer at the annual SCM and finalize the procedure, there are prospects that the November 2027 SCM could set a date within that year for the transfer recommendation. (한·미는 한미연합사령부를 대신할 미래연합군사령부의 임무수행능력 평가 검증을 3단계로 추진하고 있다. 1단계 기본운용능력(IOC) 평가·검증을 마쳤고, 2단계인 완전운용능력(FOC) 평가를 했고, 오는 11월께 열리는 한·미연례안보협의회(SCM)에서 이를 검증할 계획이다. 이 검증이 끝나면 한·미 국방장관은 전작권 전환연도를 결정하고 양국 대통령에게 건의하는 절차를 거친다. 이후 한·미 국방장관은 3단계인 완전임무수행능력(FMC) 평가·검증까지 마친 뒤 양국 대통령에게 전환 일자를 건의한다. 한·미 국방장관이 연례안보협의회에서 2027년을 전작권 전환 목표 연도로 제시하고 절차를 마무리하면, 2027년 11월 한-미 연례안보협의회에서 2027년 안에 날을 정해 전환 일자로 건의하는 것이 가능하다는 전망이 나온다.)

Meanwhile, Minister Ahn emphasized the policy of domestic construction of nuclear-powered submarines, but clarified that this policy "has not been agreed upon with the United States," stating, "Our consistent position is that it must be built domestically with our own technology, and the U.S. side is also in the process of understanding that." (한편 안 장관은 핵추진잠수함 국내 건조 방침을 강조한 뒤 이 방침이 “미국과 합의된 것은 아니다”라며 “국내에서 우리 기술로 만들어야 한다는 것이 우리의 일관된 입장이고 미측도 그렇게 이해를 하고 있는 과정”이라고 밝혔다.)

By Kwon Hyuk-chul, Reporter nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jeon Han-gil's "Lee Jae-myung Could Create Second Itaewon Disaster" Conspiracy Theory… Democratic Party Calls It "Parricidal Delusion" (전한길 “이재명 ‘제2 이태원 참사’ 만들 수도” 음모론에…민주 “패륜적 망상”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea has called for an "immediate police investigation" into far-right YouTuber Jeon Han-gil's remarks that "(the Lee Jae-myung administration) could create a second Itaewon disaster," denouncing them as a "parricidal delusion." <<> Deputy spokesperson Boo Seung-chan of the Democratic Party stated in a written briefing on the 14th, "During a live YouTube broadcast on the 12th, Jeon Han-gil made outrageous remarks suggesting the Lee Jae-myung administration could violently suppress citizens protesting the shortage of ballot papers in the June 3 local elections. He even put forward a conspiracy theory, saying 'the government could create a second Itaewon disaster.' Bringing a disaster that claimed 159 lives into the realm of political delusion is itself parricidal." <<> Previously, on the 12th, Jeon made remarks through a YouTube broadcast in front of the Olympic Handball Gymnasium in Songpa District, Seoul, where a "ballot counting site blockade protest" was held, suggesting the Lee Jae-myung administration could violently suppress the protesters. Jeon stated, "I think they could set fire inside this (handball gymnasium). Then they will lie and say that we (the protesters) went and set the fire." He added, "They will mobilize the Korean Confederation of Trade Unions or 'Gaeddle' (a slang for loyal supporters of Lee Jae-myung), 10,000 or 20,000 of them, inside to trigger a gang fight. If another bloody incident occurs, it gives them a justification to deploy the police." <<> Jeon further raised a conspiracy theory, saying, "They could create a second Itaewon disaster. The police would intervene, and because too many people are crowded, eventually they would be pushed to one side. So I think they may have welded the (entrance) door shut from the inside. In the end, they kill a bunch of people, right? The cause would be Lee Jae-myung, but the media would report it as us doing that." <<> Deputy spokesperson Boo said, "Falsely accusing the government and the Democratic Party of having intentions for a bloody suppression is clearly defamation and a serious dissemination of false information." He added, "We strongly warn against the act of using the bereaved families' tears of blood as material for conspiracy theories and dragging the government and a legitimate political party into such parricidal delusions for slander." He also noted, "Spreading such claims at a site where a crowd is gathered can itself increase the risk of an actual disaster. The responsibility is by no means light." <<> Deputy spokesperson Boo continued, "The police must immediately investigate Jeon Han-gil and hold him fully accountable. We also request stern measures to ensure that no conspiracy theories of Jeon's sort can take root." He added, "The Democratic Party will never tolerate any provocation that threatens the lives of citizens." <<> Reporter Jeon Gwang-joon light@hani.co.kr (‘개표소 봉쇄 시위’에 참석한 극우 유튜버 전한길씨가 “(이재명 정부가) 제2의 이태원 참사를 만들 수도 있다”고 발언한 것에 대해 더불어민주당이 “패륜적 망상”이라며 “경찰의 즉각 수사”를 촉구했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk Holds Out Using 'Ballot Special Counsel' as Shield; This Week's General Meeting of Lawmakers Could Be a Turning Point for His Fate (장동혁, ‘투표용지 특검’ 방패 삼아 버티기…이번주 의총 거취 분수령)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, is digging in his heels, using the push for a special counsel probe into the ballot shortage as a shield to fend off mounting calls for his resignation. The general meeting of lawmakers, expected around the 17th or 18th, is expected to be a critical turning point for Jang's future. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 투표용지 부족 사태 특검 관철을 방패 삼아 빗발치는 사퇴론을 막고 버티기에 들어갔다. 오는 17∼18일께로 예상되는 의원총회가 장 대표 거취의 분수령이 될 전망이다.)

On the 14th, young-turk lawmaker Kim Yong-tae posted on Facebook: "The leadership of a party leader who uses baseless election rigging conspiracy theories to bolster his political standing and hold onto power, while failing to resolve any real issues, must come to an end." He added, "Under Jang Dong-hyuk's leadership, we cannot institutionalize the aspirations of young people who seek to defend and advance democracy." This echoes the earlier call on the 11th by the intraparty young-turk group "Alternatives and Future," which includes Kim, demanding Jang's resignation and opposing nationwide by-elections. (소장파인 김용태 의원은 14일 페이스북에 “공당의 대표가 부정선거 음모론을 이용해 자신의 정치적 입지를 강화하고 당권을 유지하면서 실제로는 아무런 문제도 해결하지 못하는 리더십은 이제 끝내야 한다”며 “장동혁 지도부로는 민주주의 수호와 진전을 바라는 청년들의 열망을 제도화할 수 없다”고 적었다. 지난 11일 김 의원 등이 속한 당내 소장파 모임 ‘대안과 미래’가 “전국적인 재선거를 반대한다”며 장 대표의 사퇴를 촉구한 것과 같은 맥락이다.)

However, Jang countered in a Facebook post on the same day, stating: "If the government and ruling party are truly confident, they should immediately agree to discuss the special counsel probe into the ballot shortage. The investigation should be handed over to a special counsel recommended by the People Power Party." He ignored the calls for his resignation and instead emphasized the need for a special counsel. Party power-broker and Secretary-General Jeong Hee-yong also defended Jang on Facebook, writing: "Amplifying internal strife by shaking the party leader will push aside the reforms demanded by the people and the opposition's fundamental role of checking the ruling party." (그러나 장 대표는 이날 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “(정부·여당이) 정말로 떳떳하다면 당장 (투표용지 부족 사태) 특검 논의에 응해야 한다. 국민의힘이 추천하는 특검에게 수사를 맡겨야 한다”고 썼다. 자신을 향한 사퇴론은 묵살한 채 특검 필요성을 내세운 것이다. 당권파인 정희용 사무총장도 페이스북에 “당 대표 흔들기에서 시작되는 내부 갈등 증폭은, 국민이 요구하는 개혁 과제와 대여 견제라는 야당 본연의 역할을 뒷전으로 밀어내게 될 것”이라고 엄호했다.)

Amid this, attention is focused on the general meeting of lawmakers expected around the 17th or 18th. At the meeting, young-turk members, those aligned with Han Dong-hoon, and lawmakers close to Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon are likely to jointly demand Jang's resignation. However, if Jang and his supporting Supreme Council members hold firm, it will be difficult to force him out. Article 98 of the People Power Party's constitution stipulates that to transition to an emergency committee, at least four of the five elected Supreme Council members (Shin Dong-wook, Kim Min-soo, Kim Jae-won, Yang Hyang-ja, and Woo Jae-joon) must resign. So far, only Woo Jae-joon has publicly called for Jang's resignation. In calls with *The Hankyoreh* on the 14th, Shin Dong-wook and Kim Jae-won stated regarding the resignation calls: "We haven't thought about it." Meanwhile, floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik is set to meet with five-term lawmakers on the 16th to discuss Jang's fate. (이런 가운데 오는 17∼18일께 열릴 예정인 의원총회에 관심이 쏠린다. 의총에서는 소장파와 한동훈계, 오세훈 시장과 가까운 의원들이 함께 장 대표 사퇴를 촉구할 가능성이 크다. 그러나 장 대표와 장 대표 쪽 최고위원들이 버티면 그를 물러나게 할 방법이 마땅찮다. 국민의힘 당헌 제98조에는 비상대책위원회로 전환하려면 선출직 최고위원(신동욱, 김민수, 김재원, 양향자, 우재준) 5명 가운데 4명 이상이 사퇴해야 한다고 돼 있다. 이들 가운데 장 대표 퇴진을 공개 요구한 사람은 우재준 최고위원 1명뿐이다. 신동욱, 김재원 최고위원은 14일 한겨레와 한 통화에서 사퇴론에 대해 “생각해본 적이 없다”고 말했다. 이런 가운데 정점식 원내대표는 오는 16일 5선 의원들과 만나 장 대표 거취를 논의할 예정이다.)

item.title: President Lee Attends Mass at St. Paul's Basilica: "The Spark of Hope from June 15 Remains Alive" (이 대통령, 성바오로 대성당 미사 참석…“6·15 희망의 불씨 살아있다”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, on a European tour, emphasized peace on the Korean Peninsula on the 14th (local time), stating, "We plan to do everything we can to move beyond the armistice and establish a sustainable peace system." (유럽을 순방 중인 이재명 대통령이 14일(현지시각) “(남북이) 정전 상태를 넘어 지속 가능한 평화 체제를 구축하기 위해 할 수 있는 모든 것을 다할 계획”이라며 한반도 평화를 강조했다.)

During a commemorative speech at a 'Special Mass for Peace and Solidarity' presided over by Cardinal Lazarus You Heung-sik, who was appointed as the first Korean Prefect of the Dicastery for the Clergy at the Vatican, President Lee said at the Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls, "Today, the world is mired in deeper conflict and uncertainty than ever before. The thunder of war in Ukraine continues, and new clashes persist in the Middle East. The Korean Peninsula is by no means free from this reality." This marks the second time a South Korean president has delivered a commemorative speech at a special mass, following former President Moon Jae-in in October 2018. (이 대통령은 이날 로마 성밖 성바오로 대성당에서 한국인으로 최초로 교황청 성직자부 장관에 임명된 유흥식 추기경이 집전한 ‘평화와 연대를 위한 특별 미사’ 기념 연설에서 “오늘날 세계는 그 어느 때보다 깊은 갈등과 불확실성 속에 놓여 있다. 우크라이나 전쟁의 포성은 멈추지 않고, 중동에서는 새로운 충돌이 이어지고 있다. 한반도 역시 이러한 현실에서 결코 자유롭지 않다”며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령이 특별 미사에서 기념 연설을 한 것은 지난 2018년 10월 문재인 전 대통령 이후 두 번째다.)

President Lee addressed the worsening inter-Korean relations. "The South and North, which once spoke of peace and prosperity together, have returned to an era of severance," he said. "The channels of communication that connected the two Koreas have closed, and mistrust and tension remain." (이 대통령은 악화한 남북관계를 언급했다. 이 대통령은 “평화와 번영을 함께 이야기했던 남과 북은 다시 단절의 시대로 되돌아갔다”며 “남북을 연결하던 소통의 통로는 닫혔고, 불신과 긴장은 여전하다”고 말했다.)

Nevertheless, President Lee emphasized that efforts for peace on the Korean Peninsula would not cease. "Twenty-six years ago, on June 15, the South and North sat face-to-face for the first time since division and announced the June 15 Joint Declaration," he said. "It was a historic turning point that announced to the world the possibility of dialogue and cooperation, moving beyond long-standing hostility and tension. I firmly believe that the spark of that hope remains alive." (이 대통령은 그럼에도 한반도 평화를 위한 노력을 멈추지 않겠다고 강조했다. 이 대통령은 “26년 전 6월15일, 남과 북은 분단 이후 처음으로 마주 앉아 6·15 남북공동선언을 발표했다. 오랜 적대와 긴장을 넘어, 대화와 협력의 가능성을 전 세계에 알린 역사적 전환점이었다”며 “저는 지금도 그 희망의 불씨가 살아있다고 굳게 믿는다”고 말했다.)

He continued, "Since its launch last year, the South Korean government has pursued preemptive tension-reducing measures, including stopping leaflet distribution and suspending loudspeaker broadcasts toward the North." He added, "We have clearly stated that we do not pursue unification by absorption or unilateral systemic competition." President Lee further stated, "We will continue efforts to prevent accidental clashes between the two Koreas and restore military trust," and asked, "I ask you to join in prayer so that the precious words of Isaiah 2:4—'They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks'—may be realized across the nation. I hope we can together create a virtuous cycle where peace on the Korean Peninsula leads to world peace, and global solidarity once again solidifies peace on the Peninsula." (이어 “대한민국 정부는 지난해 출범 이후 전단 살포와 대북 확성기 방송 중단을 비롯한 선제적 긴장 완화 조치를 추진해 왔다”며 “흡수통일이나 일방적 체제 경쟁을 추구하지 않는다는 점을 분명히 밝혀 왔다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “남북 간 우발적 충돌을 방지하고, 군사적 신뢰를 회복하기 위한 노력도 꾸준히 이어가겠다”며 “‘칼을 쳐서 보습을 만들고, 창을 쳐서 낫을 만들리라’는 이사야서 2장4절의 귀한 말씀이 온 나라에 실현될 수 있도록 함께 기도해 주시길 부탁드린다. 한반도의 평화가 세계평화로 이어지고, 세계의 연대가 다시 한반도의 평화를 굳건하게 만드는 선순환을 함께 만들어 가길 희망한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee also conveyed a message of gratitude to the Vatican. "For a long time, the international community has wished for peace and reconciliation on the Korean Peninsula, and the Republic of Korea has steadily worked to meet those expectations and support," he said. "I take this opportunity to express my deep gratitude to the Holy See for its unwavering interest and support throughout this process." President Lee concluded, "At a time when conflict and uncertainty weigh heavily on the world, the Republic of Korea now seeks to deliver a message of hope. With the light that democracy has raised, the dignity born of a rich culture, and the future possibilities opened by science and technology and innovation, we will contribute to creating a world that is more peaceful, freer, and where everyone lives a dignified life." (교황청에도 감사 메시지를 전했다. 이 대통령은 “오랜 세월 국제사회는 한반도의 평화와 화해를 염원해 왔고, 대한민국 역시 그 기대와 성원에 부응하기 위해 꾸준히 노력해 왔다”며 “그 과정에서 한결같은 관심과 지지를 보내주신 교황청에 이 자리를 빌려 깊은 감사 인사를 드린다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “갈등과 불확실성이 세계를 무겁게 짓누르고 있는 지금, 이제 대한민국이 희망의 메시지를 전하고자 한다”며 “민주주의가 길어 올린 빛으로, 풍요로운 문화가 빚어낸 품격으로, 과학기술과 혁신이 열어가는 미래의 가능성으로 더욱 평화롭고 자유로우며 모든 이가 존엄한 삶을 누리는 세상을 만드는 데 힘을 보태겠다”고 말했다.)

Rome/Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (로마/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Cheong Wa Dae Fumes Over Chung’s ‘Regimes Are Short’ Remarks: “Isn’t This a Call to Split the Party?” (청와대, 정청래 ‘정권은 짧다’ 발언에 격앙…“당을 쪼개자는 것 아니냐”)
item.description:
Cheong Wa Dae reacted angrily on the 14th to remarks by Rep. Chung Cheong-rae of the Democratic Party of Korea, who said “The people are forever, regimes are short,” questioning, “Isn’t this essentially a call to split the party?” (청와대가 14일 정청래 더불어민주당 대표의 ‘국민은 영원하고, 정권은 짧다’는 발언과 관련해 “사실상 당을 쪼개자는 것 아니냐”는 격앙된 반응을 내놨다.)

A source close to the ruling party said, “I understand there is considerable outrage within Cheong Wa Dae over Representative Chung’s remarks,” adding, “This could lead to a division within the party.” Some have even suggested, “Isn’t this a threatening statement that implies the possibility of impeaching President Lee?” (여권 관계자는 이날 “청와대 내에서 정 대표의 발언을 상당히 격앙되게 받아들이고 있는 것으로 알고 있다”며 “당의 분열을 초래할 수 있는 발언”이라고 말했다. 일부에서는 “이 대통령의 탄핵 가능성까지 염두에 둔 협박성 발언이 아니냐”는 얘기까지 나왔다.)

While President Lee Jae-myung is on a European tour, the discomfort within Cheong Wa Dae over Representative Chung’s statement on the 11th—that “No regime can defeat the people. The people are eternal, regimes are short”—has been ongoing for days. (이재명 대통령이 유럽 순방 중인 가운데, 지난 11일 정 대표가 “국민 이기는 정권은 없다. 국민은 영원하고 정권은 짧다”라고 말한 데 대해 청와대 내부의 불쾌한 기류가 연일 이어지고 있는 것이다.)

The President’s post on X (formerly Twitter) the previous day, stating that “The ruling party’s passion should be directed toward ‘all the people,’ not ‘our own camp’” and emphasizing the need to “play the role of a ‘big vessel’ that resolves conflicts and minimizes backlash through continuous dialogue and communication, rather than confrontation and exclusion,” is also interpreted as reflecting unease toward Representative Chung. (이 대통령이 전날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “여당의 열정은 ‘우리 진영’이 아니라 ‘국민 전체’를 향해야 한다”며 “대결과 배제보다 끊임없는 대화·소통을 통해 갈등을 조정하고 반발을 최소화하는 ‘큰 그릇’ 역할을 해야 한다”고 발언한 것도 정 대표에 대한 불편한 기색을 반영한 것 아니냐는 해석이 나왔다.)

Representative Chung also did not attend the send-off event for President Lee’s European tour on the 9th. Cheong Wa Dae explained that “the number of attendees was minimized considering the domestic situation, such as the prolonged Middle East war and the poor management of the National Election Commission,” but this was seen as an unusual absence. (이 대통령의 지난 9일 유럽 순방 환송 행사에도 정 대표는 불참했다. 청와대는 “중동 전쟁의 장기화와 선거관리위원회 부실 관리 대응 등 국내 상황을 염두에 둬 환송 인원은 최소화했다”고 설명했지만, 이례적인 불참으로 여겨졌다.)

In response, Secretary General Cho Seung-rae said at a briefing that day that interpreting the President’s X post as targeting a specific leadership group is “distorting the President’s intent.” He further criticized Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, stating, “With elections in full swing, how do you think an article saying ‘He will step down as Prime Minister and seek the party leadership’ affected the election? Since the involved parties didn’t deny it, it’s accepted as true—we need to assess whether that was appropriate.” (이를 두고 조승래 사무총장은 이날 간담회에서 이 대통령의 엑스글이 특정 지도부를 겨냥하는 것으로 해석하는 것은 “대통령의 뜻을 왜곡하는 것”이라고 말했다. 그러면서 조 사무총장은 김민석 총리를 겨냥해 “선거가 한창 진행 중인데 ‘총리직을 그만두고 당권에 도전한다’는 기사가 선거에 어떤 영향을 줬겠느냐. 당사자들이 부인을 안 해서 사실로 받아들이는데 그게 과연 적절했는지 평가해볼 필요가 있다”고 말했다.)

A ruling party source commented, “Now Cheong Wa Dae is even attacking Prime Minister Kim. What does a challenge for the party leadership have to do with election results? People are saying this is a message driving the party toward division.” (여권 관계자는 “청와대에서 하다하다 이제 김 총리를 공격하느냐. 총리가 당권에 도전한다는 것이 선거 결과와 무슨 큰 상관이냐. 당을 분열로 이끄는 메시지라는 얘기가 나온다”고 말했다.)

Rome/Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (로마/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ruling and Opposition Parties Draw Swords for Election Commission Reform…Focus on 'Strengthening External Oversight', but Details Differ in Temperature (선관위 개혁 칼 빼든 여야…‘외부 감시 강화’ 초점, 세부안은 온도차)
item.description:
Triggered by the shortage of ballot papers in the June 3 local elections, the ruling and opposition parties have begun in earnest their sword-drawing reform of the National Election Commission (NEC). Both parties are focusing on reform measures to strengthen external oversight of the NEC. While the People Power Party (PPP) has been raising its voice daily for the need for a special counsel investigation in addition to a parliamentary audit to uncover the truth, the Democratic Party (DP) maintains the position that the parliamentary audit should come first. (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태로 촉발된 중앙선거관리위원회(선관위) 개혁 작업에 여야가 본격적으로 칼을 빼들었다. 여야 모두 선관위에 대한 외부 감시를 강화하는 개혁 방안에 초점을 맞췄다. 국민의힘은 진상규명을 위한 국정조사에 더해 특검이 필요하다고 연일 목소리를 높이고 있지만 더불어민주당은 국정조사가 먼저라는 입장이다.)

PPP Senior Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon said on the 14th, "The NEC's incompetence and corruption have now completely exceeded the public's patience," adding, "What is needed now is not a show of self-investigation or makeshift measures, but a special counsel and parliamentary audit to uncover the truth, and organizational reform at the level of dismantling." PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk posted on Facebook the previous day urging Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and DP leader Jung Cheong-rae, "Let's meet even today to discuss the by-election and special counsel." (최보윤 국민의힘 수석대변인은 14일 “선관위의 부실과 타락이 이제는 국민의 인내심을 완전히 넘어섰다”며 “지금 필요한 것은 보여주기식 자체 조사나 미봉책이 아니라 특검과 국정조사를 통한 진상 규명과 해체 수준의 조직 쇄신”이라고 말했다. 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 전날 페이스북에 글을 올려 김민석 국무총리와 정청래 민주당 대표를 향해 “오늘이라도 만나서 재선거와 특검을 논의하자”고 촉구했다.)

In response, DP Secretary General Cho Seung-rae stated at a press briefing on the same day, "We have already said we will take all necessary measures, including a special counsel, so I'm not sure there is a separate need to meet to discuss that part," adding, "We are currently discussing a parliamentary audit at the working level, so I think we can discuss it within that framework," indicating that the parliamentary audit should come first. (이에 대해 조승래 더불어민주당 사무총장은 이날 기자간담회에서 “특검 등 필요한 모든 조치를 하겠다고 이미 우리도 이야기했기 때문에 그 부분을 별도로 만나 이야기를 진행할 게 있을까 모르겠다”며 “실무적으로 현재 국정조사를 논의하고 있으니, 그 협의 틀 안에서 논의하면 되지 않을까 싶다”고 국정조사가 먼저라는 입장을 보였다.)

The DP and PPP are in specific negotiations over the duration and scope of the parliamentary audit. The DP plans to push for the approval of the parliamentary audit plan by the 18th, and the PPP also agrees on the need for a swift parliamentary audit. However, the DP insists that the special committee for the audit should be formed according to the proportional seat distribution in the National Assembly (10 from the DP, 6 from the PPP, 2 from non-negotiating groups), while the PPP is pushing for equal representation of 9 members each from the ruling and opposition parties. (민주당과 국민의힘은 국정조사 기간과 조사 내용 등을 둘러싼 구체적인 협상을 진행 중이다. 민주당은 오는 18일 국정조사계획서 의결을 목표로 협상을 진행한다는 계획이고, 국민의힘도 조속한 국정조사 필요성에 공감하고 있다. 다만 민주당은 국회 의석 비율대로 국조특위 위원 정수(민주당 10명, 국민의힘 6명, 비교섭단체 2명)를 꾸려야 한다는 입장이고, 국민의힘은 여야 9 대 9 동수로 해야 한다고 맞서고 있다.)

Although some PPP lawmakers argue that the government and the presidential office should also be included in the parliamentary audit's scope, Secretary General Cho drew a line on the same day, saying, "Dragging in the president, the presidential office, and the government as a political offensive is not appropriate," and "It appears to be an intention to politically exploit this incident rather than an attitude to fundamentally resolve the violation of suffrage rights." (국민의힘 일부 의원이 정부와 청와대까지 국정조사 대상으로 삼아야 한다고 주장하지만, 조 사무총장은 이날 “정치 공세 차원에서 대통령과 청와대, 정부를 끌어들이는 것은 적절하지 않다”며 “참정권 침해 사태를 근본적으로 해결하기 위한 자세라기보다는 이 사건을 정치적으로 악용하고자 하는 의도로 생각된다”고 선을 그었다.)

Lawmakers from both parties are also proposing or planning to propose bills to strengthen external oversight of the NEC. PPP lawmaker Yoo Yong-won proposed a representative amendment to the NEC Act on the 12th, centered on introducing external auditors to the NEC. The core content is to clearly stipulate in law the matters regarding the appointment of auditors, which are currently defined by NEC regulations, and to specify the qualifications for auditors as those who have served as judges, prosecutors, lawyers, or professors in legal or administrative fields for more than 10 years, thereby hiring external auditors. The bill also includes submitting annual audit reports prepared by the auditor to the National Assembly. Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon has also announced he will propose an amendment to the Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI) Act to enable the BAI to conduct job inspections of the NEC. DP lawmaker Kim Young-bae has also announced plans to introduce a bill including measures such as institutionalizing the composition and recommendation process of the NEC chairperson recommendation committee, overhauling the BAI audit system, and improving the operation of provincial and municipal-level election commissions. (여야 의원들도 선관위 외부 감시를 강화하는 법안을 발의하거나 발의할 예정이다. 유용원 국민의힘 의원은 지난 12일 선관위 외부 감사관 도입을 뼈대로 하는 선관위법 개정안을 대표 발의했다. 선관위 규칙으로 규정된 감사관 임명에 관한 사항을 법률로 명확히 규정하고 감사관의 자격요건을 판사·검사·변호사 또는 법률학·행정학 분야 교수로 10년 이상 재직한 사람으로 정해 외부 감사관을 채용하는 것이 핵심 내용이다. 또 감사관이 작성한 연간 감사보고서를 국회에 제출하도록 하는 내용도 담고 있다. 한동훈 무소속 의원 역시 선관위에 대한 감사원의 직무감찰을 가능하게 하는 감사원법 개정안을 발의하겠다고 예고했다. 김영배 더불어민주당 의원도 선관위원장 추천위원회 구성과 추천 절차 제도화, 감사원 감사 제도 정비, 시·도 및 시·군·구 선관위 운영 개선 등의 내용을 담은 법안을 내겠다고 예고했다.)

This is aimed at improving the current situation where the NEC, a constitutionally independent body, only receives accounting audits from the BAI regarding budget execution, effectively blocking external oversight. However, as the NEC is a constitutionally independent body, there are opinions from both parties that amending the constitution is necessary to strengthen audits, change the composition of commissioners, or expand grounds for dismissing commissioners. (이는 헌법상 독립기관인 선관위가 감사원으로부터 예산 집행에 대한 회계감사만 받고, 사실상 외부 감시가 차단된 현 실태를 개선해야 한다는 취지다. 하지만 선관위가 헌법상 독립기관인 만큼, 감사를 강화하거나 위원 구성을 변경하고 위원 파면 사유를 확대하려면 개헌이 필요하다는 의견도 여야 모두에서 나오고 있다.)

item.title: "Government is short-lived" Jeong Cheong-rae's remarks spark backlash... Blue House furious, calling them "threatening remarks" (“정권은 짧다” 정청래 발언 후폭풍…청 “협박성 발언 아니냐” 격앙)
item.description:
The conflict between the Democratic Party and the Blue House is escalating over the blame for the local elections placed on Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae and his potential candidacy for the August party convention. On the 14th, inside the Blue House, there were heated reactions to Jeong's remarks that "The people are eternal, and the government is short-lived," with some asking, "Isn't this an attempt to split the party?" There is also speculation that President Lee Jae-myung's post on X the previous day—stating, "The ruling party's passion should be directed toward 'the entire people,' not 'our camp'"—was a third push for Jeong to step down. <<> Amid President Lee's ongoing European tour, displeasure within the Blue House toward Jeong is intensifying. A ruling party official commented on Jeong's remarks from the 11th—"No government can outlast the people. The people are eternal, and the government is short-lived"—saying, "I understand that the Blue House is taking his remarks very seriously. They could lead to division within the party." According to reports, some in the Blue House even suggested the remarks were "threatening, as if considering the possibility of President Lee's impeachment." <<> President Lee's post on X, titled "The Ruling Party, the Opposition, and Political Responsibility," included the line, "We should focus more on the language of responsibility than the language of conviction." Many interpret this as a critique of Jeong's management of the party, which centers on hardline supporters. This is seen as the third veto against the ruling party leadership, following President Lee's public warning at his first-year anniversary press conference on the 8th—"The ruling party must act as a vessel"—and his decision not to invite Jeong to the send-off event for the European tour on the 9th. Non-mainstream lawmaker Lee Yong-woo referenced President Lee's post on Facebook on the 13th, writing, "I hope the leadership will no longer burden the government." <<> As pressure mounts from the Blue House and non-mainstream factions within the party, Jeong has remained silent over the weekend with no public schedule or statements. On the 12th, he posted a brief note on Facebook about the "complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers," hinting at a frontal breakthrough. However, the escalating party-Blue House conflict seems to deepen his dilemma. A mainstream lawmaker said, "He will likely make a decision one way or another soon." Inside and outside the party, there are expectations that Jeong will decide whether to run in the August 17 party convention before the 24th, when the Democratic Party is set to establish a convention preparation committee. There is also talk that President Lee might meet with Jeong after his European tour. <<> While Jeong remains silent, Secretary-General Jo Seung-rae has directly refuted the blame placed on Jeong for the local elections. At a press briefing at the National Assembly today, Jo stated, "We produced the first female regional governor [Choo Mi-ae, Gyeonggi Province Governor] and achieved record-breaking wins in basic local government heads. Even compared to the best results in 2018, this is top-tier." Regarding President Lee's X post, Jo added, "Narrowing it down to specific individuals or the leadership distorts the president's intent." <<> Notably, Jo mentioned that the evaluation work of the "June 3 Local and By-elections Assessment Committee" would include "the actions of government figures," targeting Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, a potential rival for Jeong in the party leadership race. Jo asked, "While the election was in full swing, how much impact do you think articles about 'resigning as prime minister to challenge for party leadership' had on the election?" In response, non-mainstream lawmaker Lee Geon-tae criticized on Facebook, "What does the prime minister's resignation or potential bid for party leadership have to do with evaluating the local elections? Jeong and Jo should be subject to evaluation themselves. They should resign immediately." <<> Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (정청래 더불어민주당 대표의 지방선거 책임론과 8월 전당대회 출마 여부를 둘러싼 당-청 갈등이 격화하고 있다. 청와대 내부에서는 14일 “국민은 영원하고 정권은 짧다”고 한 정청래 대표 발언을 두고 “당을 쪼개자는 것 아니냐”는 격앙된 반응이 터져 나왔다. 이재명 대통령이 전날 “여당의 열정은 ‘우리 진영’이 아니라 ‘국민 전체’를 향해야 한다”는 글을 엑스(X)에 올린 것도 정 대표를 향한 세번째 거취 압박이란 해석도 나온다.)

item.title: Cheong Wa Dae "Hope for US-Iran War Termination Agreement... Hoping It Will Lead to Swift Opening of the Strait of Hormuz" (청와대 “미·이란 종전 합의 기대…호르무즈 해협 조속 개방 계기 되길”)
item.description:
On the 14th (local time), Cheong Wa Dae stated ahead of the signing of a memorandum of understanding (MOU) between the United States and Iran to end the war, "We expect that an agreement between the two sides will be reached, restoring peace and stability in the Middle East and providing an opportunity for the swift opening of the Strait of Hormuz." (청와대가 14일(현지시각) 미국과 이란이 전쟁 종식을 위한 양해각서(MOU) 서명을 앞두고 “양측 간 합의가 타결되어 중동 지역의 평화와 안정이 회복되고 호르무즈 해협의 조속한 개방이 이루어지는 계기가 되기를 기대한다”고 말했다.)

A Cheong Wa Dae official said, "The government has been closely monitoring the progress of the MOU negotiations between the United States and Iran to end the war, and in this regard, we take note of President Trump's remarks. The government supports President Trump's related efforts and will continue to participate in the international community's efforts, including those of the United States, for free and safe navigation in the Strait of Hormuz." (청와대 관계자는 이날 “정부는 미국과 이란 간 종전 양해각서 협상 진행 상황을 면밀히 주시해왔으며, 이러한 점에서 트럼프 대통령의 발언에 주목한다”며 “정부는 트럼프 대통령의 관련 노력을 지지하며, 호르무즈 해협에서의 자유롭고 안전한 항행을 위한 미국을 포함한 국제사회의 노력에 지속적으로 동참해나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

Earlier, Reuters (local time) reported, citing a high-ranking Iranian official, that the final draft of the MOU to end the war between the United States and Iran includes provisions such as the immediate opening of the Strait of Hormuz. (앞서 로이터통신(현지시각)은 이날 미국과 이란의 전쟁 종식을 위한 양해각서(MOU) 최종안에 호르무즈 해협의 즉각적인 개방 등의 내용이 포함됐다고 이란 고위 관리를 인용해 보도했다.)

Vatican/Seo Young-ji Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (바티칸/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee in Video Conference: "Election Rigging Claims Preposterous Conspiracy Theory... Antisocial Behavior" (이 대통령, 화상 회의서 “부정선거론, 터무니없는 음모론…반사회적 행태”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, currently on a European tour, convened a video conference with senior aides on the 14th (local time) and stated, "Spreading claims of election rigging by alleging manipulation of election results is an antisocial act that distorts the essence of this issue and insults the valuable voices of the people." (유럽을 순방 중인 이재명 대통령이 14일(현지시각) 화상 수석보좌관 회의를 열고 “선거결과 조작 등을 운운하면서 부정선거론을 퍼뜨리는 것은 이 문제의 본질을 왜곡하고 국민들의 귀한 목소리를 모욕하는 반사회적 행태”라고 말했다.)

During the video conference with senior aides held from the Vatican, President Lee said, "There's something I find problematic every time I look into it. As you all know, it's an issue of suffrage infringement." He added, "This is fundamental to democracy. How did we end up in such a situation? It is truly absurd and baffling." He further commented, "While I fully acknowledge and accept the legitimate concerns raised by our citizens regarding suffrage infringement, some factions are exploiting this to stir up baseless conspiracy theories, making themselves more vocal. This incident, triggered by the National Election Commission's inexcusable poor ballot management, is leaving a serious stain on the national prestige of South Korea, which takes pride in its K-democracy, cutting-edge industries, and K-culture." This marks the first time a president has held a video conference with senior secretaries and aides while on an overseas trip. (이 대통령은 바티칸 현지에서 주재한 화상 수석보좌관 회의에서 “제가 자꾸 들여다볼 때마다 문제다 싶은 게 있다. 여러분 다 아시는 것처럼 참정권 침해의 문제”라며 “이것은 민주주의의 근본이라고 할 수 있는데 어쩌다 이런 일까지 벌어지고 있는지 참으로 황당하고, 당황스럽다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “참정권 침해에 대한 우리 국민들의 정당한 문제 제기를 다 인정하고 수용한다”면서도 “그런데 이걸 악용을 해가지고 이 터무니없는 음모론을 선동하는 세력들이 더 고개를 들고 있다. 변명의 여지없는 선관위의 투표 관리 부실로 촉발된 이번 사태는 케이(K)-민주주의, 첨단산업, 케이-컬처를 자랑하는 대한민국의 국격에 심각한 오점을 남기고 있다”고 말했다. 대통령이 해외 순방 중 수석·비서관과 영상으로 수석보좌관 회의를 여는 건 이번이 처음이다.)

President Lee issued stern instructions to take decisive action against those propagating election fraud theories who threaten citizens nearby. He stated, "Moreover, among those spreading such claims, some are assaulting on-site police officers, threatening nearby citizens, occasionally conducting inexplicable searches or checkpoints, blocking access, and obstructing work. They must be held appropriately accountable according to the law and principles." He added, "No matter what we do, there are boundaries we must uphold, and wouldn't the clearest line be the law and institutions? To turn the suffrage infringement incident into a chance for strengthening democracy and popular sovereignty, we need to ensure healthy criticism and constructive alternatives, which must go hand in hand. To achieve this, we must accelerate a thorough and transparent investigation to uncover the truth." (이 대통령은 주변 시민 등을 위협하는 부정 선거론자에 대해선 단호한 대응을 지시했다. 이 대통령은 “더구나 이런(부정선거) 주장을 펴는 사람들 가운데 일부는 현장 경찰관을 상대로 위해를 가하기도 하고, 또 주변 시민들을 위협하기도 하고, 가끔씩 이해할 수 없는 무슨 검색 검문 행위도 하고 또 출입도 막고 이렇게 업무방해를 하고 있는 것 같다”며 “마땅히 법과 원칙에 따라서 합당한 책임을 물어야 되겠다”고 말했다. 그러면서 이 대통령은 “우리가 뭘 하더라도 지켜야 될 선이 있는데, 그중에서 가장 명확한 선이 법과 제도 아니겠냐”며 “국민 참정권 침해 사건을 민주주의와 국민주권 강화를 위한 전화위복의 계기로 삼으려면 건강한 비판과 건설적 대안 마련이 보장되고 또 함께 이루어져야 된다. 이를 위해 철저하고 투명한 진상 규명에 속도를 낼 필요가 있다”고 말했다.)

The President requested the National Election Commission to fully cooperate with the parliamentary audit. He said, "I hear the special committee for the audit will be operational as early as this week. The joint investigation team of the prosecution and police must also intensify efforts to assign responsibility without exceptions. It is time for our society to respond with responsible actions to the just anger of our youth and citizens." (중앙선거관리위원회(선관위)에는 국회 국정조사에 대한 전폭적인 협조를 요청했다. 이 대통령은 “빠르면 이번 주부터 국정조사 특위가 가동된다고 한다”며 “검경 합수본 역시 성역 없는 책임 규명에 박차를 가해야 되겠다. 청년들과 시민들의 정의로운 분노에 우리 사회 모두가 책임 있는 행동으로 응답할 때”라고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, the ruling and opposition parties have embarked on reforming the National Election Commission, triggered by the ballot shortage during the June 3 local elections. The Democratic Party and the People Power Party are in specific negotiations over the duration and scope of the parliamentary audit. The Democratic Party aims to finalize the audit plan by the 18th, while the People Power Party also acknowledges the need for a swift audit. However, the Democratic Party insists on forming the special committee proportional to the party seat distribution in the National Assembly (10 from the Democratic Party, 6 from the People Power Party, and 2 from non-affiliated groups), whereas the People Power Party argues for an equal composition of 9 members each from the ruling and opposition parties. (한편 여야는 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태로 촉발된 선관위 개혁 작업에 나섰다. 더불어민주당과 국민의힘은 국정조사 기간과 조사 내용 등을 둘러싼 구체적인 협상을 진행 중이다. 민주당은 오는 18일 국정조사계획서 의결을 목표로 협상을 진행한다는 계획이고, 국민의힘도 조속한 국정조사 필요성에 공감하고 있다. 다만 민주당은 국회 의석 비율대로 국조특위 위원 정수(민주당 10명, 국민의힘 6명, 비교섭단체 2명)를 꾸려야 한다는 입장이고, 국민의힘은 여야 9 대 9 동수로 해야 한다고 맞서고 있다.)

Lawmakers from both parties are planning or have already proposed bills to strengthen external oversight of the National Election Commission. Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Young-bae announced a bill that includes institutionalizing the composition and recommendation process of the Election Commission Chair Recommendation Committee, revamping the Board of Audit and Inspection's audit system, and improving the operations of city/provincial and district/county election commissions. People Power Party lawmaker Yoo Yong-won proposed an amendment to the Election Commission Act on the 12th, centered on introducing external auditors for the commission. (여야 의원들도 선관위 외부 감시를 강화하는 법안을 발의하거나 발의할 예정이다. 김영배 민주당 의원은 선관위원장 추천위원회 구성과 추천 절차 제도화, 감사원 감사 제도 정비, 시·도 및 시·군·구 선관위 운영 개선 등의 내용을 담은 법안을 내겠다고 예고했다. 유용원 국민의힘 의원은 지난 12일 선관위 외부 감사관 도입을 뼈대로 하는 선관위법 개정안을 대표 발의했다.)

Vatican/Reporters Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr and Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (바티칸/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee says of Jamsil protests: “We must strictly address obstruction of work” (이 대통령, 잠실 시위에 “업무방해 행위 엄정 대처해야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, on an official visit to the Vatican, held a video conference with senior secretaries on the 14th (local time) and commented regarding the behavior of protesters demonstrating against the ‘ballot shortage incident’ at the National Election Commission, saying, “Shouldn’t we strictly address the obstruction of work through private inspections and intimidation among the protesters’ actions?” (바티칸을 공식 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 14일(현지시각) 화상 수석보좌관회의를 열고 중앙선거관리위원회 ‘투표용지 부족 사태'에 항의하는 시위대의 행태와 관련해 “시위대의 행태 중 사적 검문 및 위력을 동원한 업무 방해 행위는 엄정 대처해야 하는 거 아니냐”고 말했다.)

Senior Press Secretary Kang Yu-jung reported that President Lee responded this way during the senior secretaries’ meeting he chaired locally, after receiving a report from the Office of the Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs that a joint investigation team had been formed by police and prosecutors to investigate, in connection with the infringement of citizens’ voting rights. (이 대통령은 이날 현지에서 주재한 수석보좌관회의에서 국민의 참정권 침해와 관련해 검경 합동수사본부가 구성돼 수사를 진행하고 있다는 민정수석실의 보고를 받고 이렇게 반문했다고 강유정 수석대변인이 전했다.)

Earlier, in his opening remarks at the meeting, President Lee stated, “We acknowledge and accept all legitimate questions raised by the people regarding the ‘infringement of voting rights.’” He then pointed out, “However, forces are emerging that exploit this to stir up baseless conspiracy theories. Spreading claims of election fraud while mentioning manipulation of election results distorts the essence of the issue and disrespects the valuable voices of the people—this is an anti-social behavior.” (앞서 이 대통령은 회의 모두발언에서 “‘참정권 침해’에 대한 국민들의 정당한 문제 제기를 다 인정하고 수용한다”면서 “그런데 이걸 악용해 터무니없는 음모론을 선동하는 세력이 고개를 들고 있다. 선거 결과 조작을 운운하면서 부정선거론을 퍼뜨리는 건 문제의 본질을 왜곡하고, 국민들의 귀한 목소리를 모욕하는 반사회적 행태”라고 지적했다.)

President Lee reportedly inquired whether there were any complaints from frontline public officials after receiving a report from the Office of the Senior Presidential Secretary for Personnel on a plan to improve the overtime pay system for civil servants. He then “ordered the establishment of control measures to prevent fraudulent receipt, misuse, and exploitation,” to ensure that reasonable changes breaking long-standing practices can be properly implemented, according to reports. Additionally, regarding the ‘youth policy’ prepared by the Office of the Senior Presidential Secretary for Communication and Integration, he asked that concrete means and methods be developed so that even small policies can be easily felt by young people. (이 대통령은 이어 인사수석실의 ‘공무원 대상 초과근무 수당 제도 개선 방안’을 보고받고 일선 공무원들의 불만이 없는지 물었다고 한다. 그러면서 “이 대통령은 오랜 관행을 바꿀 합리적인 변화가 제대로 적용될 수 있게 부정 수령과 남용 및 악용에 대한 통제 수단 장치를 마련해 달라고 주문했다”고 전했다. 또 경청통합수석실이 마련한 ‘청년 정책’과 관련해서는 작은 정책이라도 청년들이 쉽게 체감할 수 있게 구체적 수단과 방법을 마련해 달라고 당부했다.)

Furthermore, President Lee heard a report from the Office of the Senior Presidential Secretary for Economic Affairs on the state of financial markets and the insolvency of listed companies. He stated that institutional safeguards should be put in place to weed out problematic elements and ensure the health of the stock market. President Lee emphasized the importance of securing investor confidence by cleaning up the overall stock market, from small-cap stocks to blue-chip stocks. (아울러 이 대통령은 경제성장수석실로부터 금융시장 상황 및 상장기업 부실화 현황을 보고받고, 제도적 보완 장치를 마련해 털어낼 부분은 털어내 주식시장을 건전화해야 한다고 말했다. 이 대통령은 소형주부터 우량주까지 우리 주식시장 전반을 건전화해 투자자의 신뢰감을 확보하는 게 중요하다고 강조했다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee received a report from the Office of the Senior Presidential Secretary for Social Affairs on the trends in deliberation over the minimum wage for 2027. Senior Press Secretary Kang reported that President Lee pointed out, “In South Korea, the minimum wage applies uniformly by region and industry, and there seems to be a need for a more detailed explanation of the concept of the national minimum wage.” (또 이 대통령은 사회수석실로부터 ‘2027년 적용 최저임금 심의 동향’을 보고받았다. 이 대통령은 “우리나라는 최저임금이 지역별, 업종별로 동일하게 적용되는데, 국가가 정한 최저임금의 개념에 대한 설명이 구체적으로 필요한 것 같다고 지적했다”고 강 수석대변인은 전했다.)

After hearing a report from the Office of the Senior Presidential Secretary for AI Future Planning on the progress of establishing the ‘Second Space Center,’ President Lee ordered, “Please carefully review various factors such as efficiency, economic feasibility, and balanced development elements when selecting the site.” (이 대통령은 에이아이(AI)미래기획수석실로부터 ‘제2 우주센터 건립 추진’ 상황을 보고받은 뒤에는 “부지 선정에 있어 효율성과 경제성, 균형개발 요소 등 다양한 요소들을 잘 검토해 달라”고 주문했다)

Rome/Seo Young-ji, reporter yj@hani.co.kr (로마/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Jung Wook-sik Column] The More Sincere the U.S. Is About “North Korean Denuclearization,” the More Dangerous It Becomes for South Korea ([정욱식 칼럼] 미국이 “북한 비핵화”에 진심일수록 한국도 위험해진다)
item.description:
The war of nerves surrounding the Korean Peninsula, or “North Korean denuclearization,” continues. The U.S. said it reaffirmed the principle of denuclearization at the U.S.-China summit held in mid-May, but China remained completely silent. And at the North Korea-China summit held in Pyongyang on June 8-9, the denuclearization issue was not mentioned at all. Instead, it was agreed to upgrade North Korea-China relations to a “strategic partnership” and significantly strengthen exchange and cooperation in various fields, including the economy. At the South Korea-European Union (EU) summit held two days later, it was stated that “the commitment to complete denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula was reaffirmed.” <<> South Korea, together with its allies, has reaffirmed the principle of denuclearization based on the judgment that it serves our interests and security. However, it is time to calmly examine whether our insistence on denuclearization truly benefits the national interest. From the push for a North Korea-U.S. summit, which the Lee Jae-myung administration has been working hard on, to the scenarios that would unfold the more sincere the U.S. is about denuclearization, examining them one by one reveals that the results could run counter to our security and interests. In particular, there are issues to consider from the perspective of preventing war, which can be considered a matter of life and death for us. <<> Having gone through the summit with China, the possibility that North Korea will respond to a summit with the U.S., which has denuclearization as its agenda, has become even more remote. This means that a North Korea-U.S. summit will only become possible when the U.S. abandons its demand for denuclearization. Accordingly, for the Lee Jae-myung administration to contribute to the realization of a North Korea-U.S. summit, it should be able to suggest to the Trump administration that it no longer demand denuclearization from North Korea. While this is unlikely, it is clear that adhering to denuclearization and achieving a North Korea-U.S. summit are incompatible. <<> We can also imagine a scenario where President Donald Trump, who has long hoped for a meeting with Chairman Kim Jong-un, abandons denuclearization for the sake of the summit, but then brings up the issue of denuclearization in the meeting with Chairman Kim. What would happen then? The summit would likely break down. The more sincere Trump is about denuclearization, the more that will be the case. The same would apply even if Trump agrees to make denuclearization a long-term goal and suggests first discussing the “freeze and reduction of North Korea’s nuclear weapons” and corresponding measures. This is because, for North Korea, denuclearization has become a taboo word and a thing of the past. <<> Nevertheless, the more sincerely the U.S. pursues the dismantlement of North Korea’s nuclear weapons, the more our interests and security will inevitably be jeopardized. Many domestic and international experts unanimously say there is no possibility that the Kim Jong-un regime will abandon its nuclear capabilities. Accordingly, if North Korea, which pursues irreversible nuclear-armed state status, faces off against a U.S. that is genuine about denuclearization, the uncertainty of the situation on the Korean Peninsula could escalate extremely. For example, let’s assume that Trump, a believer in the “madman theory,” says “North Korea must give up its nuclear weapons” and issues maximized pressure with the implied threat that “there are ways through dialogue and also other ways.” If Trump once again unleashes rhetoric like “fire and fury” or “total destruction of North Korea,” as he did in 2017, how would North Korea react? And if the U.S. goes beyond rhetoric and, as it did in September 2017, flies strategic bombers skimming the Military Demarcation Line and North Korean airspace to intimidate North Korea? At that time, North Korea was unaware of it, but what if, having strengthened its intelligence assets since, it detects such actions now? North Korea, with its nuclear capabilities incomparably stronger than in 2017, would respond fiercely, “words with words” and “actions with actions.” <<> If tensions between North Korea and the U.S. escalate to a point of imminent crisis like this, our economy would suffer a severe blow. The brinkmanship between the two sides in the second half of 2017 was perhaps based on calculations of negotiating from a position of strength. However, a renewed escalation of military tensions between North Korea and the U.S. would be qualitatively different this time. Unlike nine years ago, there is no clear way to turn a crisis back into negotiations. <<> In June of last year, the U.S. launched Operation Midnight Hammer against Iran, with which it was in negotiations, carrying out a preemptive strike on Iran’s key nuclear facilities. This brings to mind discussions within the first Trump administration about considering a “bloody nose” operation against North Korea. It was a concept born from the idea of “if words don’t work and intimidation doesn’t work, what if we hit them hard once?” What would happen if the U.S. launched a preemptive strike against North Korea, whether a “bloody nose” operation or a “Midnight Hammer”? And what if the “decapitation strike,” which killed the Iranian leadership in February this year, were carried out against the Kim Jong-un regime? <<> Just as Iran retaliated against U.S. military bases in the Middle East, North Korea could also retaliate against a U.S. preemptive strike by attacking U.S. bases in South Korea or Japan. If the U.S. then chooses escalation and South Korea or Japan, or both, engage in military action against North Korea, the flames of war would grow uncontrollably. Moreover, the possibility of intervention by China and Russia, which have alliances with North Korea containing automatic intervention clauses, cannot be ruled out. If the U.S. and its allies launch a “decapitation strike,” claiming that North Korea’s use of nuclear weapons is imminent, the likelihood of North Korea using nuclear weapons “automatically” in accordance with its already-proclaimed nuclear doctrine also increases. <<> I am not mentioning these scenarios, which we don’t even want to imagine, because I believe the situation on the Korean Peninsula is highly likely to unfold in this direction. The U.S. would not be so reckless as to choose war against North Korea, which possesses strong retaliatory capabilities. Nor is our Republic of Korea Israel, which coaxed the U.S. into setting the Middle East ablaze. The reason for mentioning these horrifying scenarios is that I believe it is now time for us to break free from the “denuclearization frame.” <<> This reasoning can also be found in the relationship between the North Korean nuclear issue and “war and peace.” Since the early 1990s, when the so-called “North Korean nuclear issue” emerged, the risk of war on the Korean Peninsula has mainly arisen amid repeated cycles of negotiations and breakdowns. There have been concerns that if the U.S. fails to achieve denuclearization through pressure and dialogue, it could consider the use of force, and that an actual preemptive strike against North Korea could lead to a full-scale war due to North Korea’s retaliation. Paradoxically, however, after North Korea’s nuclear armament, discussions about a U.S. preemptive strike against the North have disappeared. And until a few years ago, there were concerns in some domestic and international circles that “North Korea would attempt unification by force, backed by nuclear weapons,” with various South Korean and U.S. research institutions putting forward related scenarios. Yet, North Korea, by declaring the “two-state theory,” says it will even abandon unification. This means the purpose of its nuclear forces is not “changing the status quo” (unification) but “maintaining the status quo” (two states). <<> In recent times, with Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and the U.S.-Israel invasion of Iran, the perception that “if you lack deterrence, you will be attacked” is becoming globalized. As “self-reliance” emerges as the watchword of the era, South Korea is at the forefront. While “modernizing” its alliance with the U.S., it is also pouring massive budgets into building an independent national defense capability. In this context, the demand for denuclearization can only sound to North Korea like “give up your war deterrence.” <<> It is uncomfortable and hard to admit, but it’s no exaggeration to say denuclearization has come to an end. Now it’s time to find alternatives. The <<> core of the alternative lies in seeking peaceful coexistence not with a “non-nuclear North Korea” but with a “nuclear-armed North Korea.” Transitional alternatives are already emerging in some domestic and international circles. Instead of clinging to denuclearization, they suggest pursuing arms control negotiations aimed at freezing and reducing nuclear weapons. And a clue to the ultimate alternative has been proposed by Trump. It is the idea of having major powers like the U.S., Russia, and China first pursue nuclear disarmament, and then invite North Korea to join in. Isn’t it time for us to publicly advocate that we put the North Korean nuclear issue within the larger framework of “nuclear war and a world without nuclear weapons”? <<> Jung Wook-sik, Director of the Hankyoreh Peace Research Institute and Representative of Peace Network, wooksik@gmail.com (한반도, 혹은 “북한 비핵화”를 둘러싼 신경전이 여전하다. 미국은 5월 중순에 열린 미중정상회담에서 비핵화 원칙을 재확인했다고 했지만, 중국은 철저하게 침묵을 지켰다. 그리고 6월 8〜9일에 평양에서 열린 조중 정상회담에선 비핵화 문제가 일체 언급되지 않았다. 대신 조중 관계를 ‘전략적 동반자’로 격상하고 경제를 비롯한 각 분야의 교류협력을 대폭 강화키로 한 합의가 나왔다. 이틀 후에 열린 한국-유럽연합(EU) 정상회담에선 “한반도의 완전한 비핵화 의지를 재확인”한다고 했다.)
